mission: Collector rollout for PR #223 (Yuyu-Tei one-shot source probe and the SNKRDUNK CSS-module class fix), merged by hand at 0edf2a7 on 2026-10-26 14:28Z. #223 carried hold-for-owner (it touches .github/workflows/ops-write.yml), and a hand merge only runs Verify staging merge, so the ten collectors still run the previous release and Verify failed. This PR changes no code: it carries the same collector_services request so staging-automerge releases the ten collectors one at a time on its merge commit (which contains #223), each restored to its recovery deployment on failure, then verifies staging. The owner marks this draft ready to approve the release. STAGING_DELIVERY.md records the rule so a held collector change is split or followed up the same way.

impacts.reason: Records that a hand merge never rolls out collectors and how a held collector change is delivered. The infrastructure effect is this PR's purpose: the mission-scoped release of all ten staging collectors on the merge commit.

resources: Yuyu-Tei source dispatch budget, only through the owner-approved probe
routes: one metered Yuyu-Tei product capture per owner-approved probe, from the collectors' network
SNKRDUNK product pages parsed again (no change to which pages are fetched)
dependencies: then a fleet-pin PR (yuyu_reader_component and snkr_component to this merge SHA)
impact.deployment_impact: Collector release of #223's code: every collector re-uploaded on the merge commit in its own slot with automatic rollback. Behaviour changes: SNKRDUNK pages parse again; Yuyu-Tei stays paused until an owner-approved probe.

recovery.procedure: Collectors: the sequential rollout restores every touched collector on failure; afterwards collector-redeploy to the previous fleet pin. Code: native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: A collector failing after release, a probe resuming without a verified capture, or SNKRDUNK captures still refused (or prices mis-parsed) after release.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify; SNKRDUNK captures resume with images and prices on the next SNKR turns (staging-state); then yuyu-source-probe dry run, owner-approved apply, and staging-state after the next Yuyu turn.
